ui_help_back: Return to the game menu. Settings are saved automatically.
ui_help_background_audio: Mute game audio while the game window is not focused.
ui_help_bindings: Q: clear a binding. R: restore its default. These shortcuts apply outside key capture.
ui_help_cheat_warning: (Not recommended) CHEAT: Enabling this feature will alter the game's original design and intended experience.
ui_help_confine_cursor: Keep the pointer inside the game window during gameplay.
ui_help_console: Show BepInEx's console for log output.
ui_help_cursor_size: Diameter at 1080p. The sprite scales with the window height.
ui_help_exploding_arrow: While aiming Shoot Magic, press Attack to trigger Exploding Arrow Magic. The original combination remains available.
ui_help_frame_rate: SiNi original uses the game's frame pacing. A frame cap or Unlimited disables V-sync.
ui_help_fullscreen: Use a borderless window at the desktop resolution. Turning this off restores the window size and disables V-sync.
ui_help_hide_hud: Hide the HP/MP gauges, status effects, and Name and Relics tags, including their labels and values.
ui_help_hide_portrait: Hide the character portrait and move the HP/MP gauge to the lower left, with Name and Relics to its right.
ui_help_navigation:
Hybrid menu navigation with mouse, keyboard, and gamepad support and additional key bindings.
Inspired by Akiloneus's doujin game project—Rabiane.
ui_help_preserve_aspect: Preserve the game's original 2:1 aspect ratio at any resolution. Unused space is black.
ui_help_vsync: Synchronize frames with the display. Enabling V-sync also enables Fullscreen and SiNi original frame pacing.
